title: Eddie Gilmore, bass player, and T-Boy
summary: The men sort out the bass player's name as Eddie Gilmore, and Allen links it to T-Boy Gilmore and his own father.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: I wonder about that place player. His name was Eddie, huh? What other bands did he play with? Yeah.
Nah. First time I saw him, he played with the Liberty Bell Band. That's been a long time ago.
Eddie Gilmore. His name is Gilmore. Eddie Gilmore.
T-Boy, that's who I thought you were talking about.
T-Boy Gilmore. Because he and Dad were great buddies.
